title: Great CX Is Built around the Customer
summary: See how Everpure PEAK certification and CX RESERVE earned 2026 Brandon Hall Group and SAMA awards for customer experience built around the customer.
body_markdown:
### Summary


Two Everpure customer experience programs—PEAK training and certification and CX Reserve strategic partnerships—help customers build expertise and advance their business priorities. Both have earned industry recognition in 2026.


I believe great customer experience (CX) comes from helping customers make progress, consistently, at every stage of their journey. That takes more than one strong interaction. It takes people who understand the technology, support teams who bring insight and expertise together, and partners who stay focused on what matters to each customer’s business.


That’s the work we’re building across CX at Everpure. Our programs help customers and partners build practical skills, give our teams better ways to support customers, and create space for deeper strategic partnerships.


In 2026, two of those programs received external recognition. Our[Performance, Education, and Knowledge (PEAK) Certification Program](https://www.everpuredata.com/services/peak-data-storage-training-and-certifications.html) earned Silver for Best Certification Program in the[Brandon Hall Group™ HCM Excellence Awards](https://brandonhall.com/brandon-hall-group-announces-winners-of-the-2026-hcm-excellence-awards/) ® for the third consecutive year. CX Reserve earned the[Strategic Account Management Association (](https://strategicaccounts.org/sama-excellence-awards/) SAMA) Excellence Award for Outstanding Young Program of the Year (less than five years old).


These awards are important recognition for the teams behind the programs. They also reflect capabilities that matter to customers: building confidence and practical expertise, combining technology with human judgment, and bringing the right people together around customer priorities.


## **PEAK: Helping customers and partners showcase practical expertise**


Customers and partners need more than product familiarity. They need skills they can apply across an integrated platform and in real-world situations. PEAK is evolving to meet that need, moving beyond product-level testing toward scenarios that reflect how people use the platform across systems and environments.


The PEAK program continues to adapt as our platform and customer needs change. PEAK brings together training, technical knowledge, community resources, and certification to help people build and demonstrate practical expertise. As the[Everpure Platform](https://www.everpuredata.com/platform.html) evolves, the program continues to update its exams and supporting learning resources. In FY26, candidates completed 2,925 exams, an 11% increase year over year, and earned 1,577 certifications across approximately 1,100 individuals. This brought the total number of certifications awarded since launch to more than 4,200.


Trust matters, too. A certification is valuable only when people can rely on what it represents. To help protect exam integrity, PEAK uses multiple layers of security, including identity verification, AI-enabled proctoring, human oversight, and post-exam analytics. These measures help identify suspicious activity during testing and patterns that may require further investigation afterward. Technology helps identify signals at scale; human judgment and oversight help ensure the process is handled carefully.


The goal is simple: help employees, partners, and customers build skills they can prove, trust, and put to work across the platform. That focus has earned PEAK certification a Brandon Hall Group™ HCM Excellence Award® three years running.


## **CX Reserve: Building strategic partnerships around customer priorities**


A strong strategic partnership starts with understanding what the customer is trying to achieve and aligning the right people across our company to support those priorities.


CX Reserve brings a customer-first mindset to strategic account relationships. Designed for a select group of global enterprise customers, the program focuses on understanding their business priorities and orchestrating Everpure expertise around them. The program is built like a product, complete with a roadmap, customer feedback loops, dedicated governance, and a commitment to continuous improvement.


That structure creates room for deeper collaboration through success planning that ties Everpure capabilities directly to customer outcomes, dedicated account roles, and cross-functional engagement. After launching with five customers, CX Reserve has expanded to 11 strategic accounts, with plans to scale in the future. This momentum has helped Everpure earn the SAMA award. To me, this honor reflects the work behind the results: listening closely, coordinating across teams, and staying focused on each customer’s goals.


Our commitment to listening is reflected in how our customers feel about us. Everpure achieved an[NPS of 84](https://blog.everpuredata.com/perspectives/pure-storage-84-nps/) (the average NPS in tech is 35), and we’ve maintained an audited NPS above 80 for a decade. We value the trust our customers place in us and know we have to keep earning it.


## **Bringing technology and human expertise together**


Technology can help our teams see customer needs sooner and respond with more context.[Pure1](https://www.everpuredata.com/products/monitoring-fleet-management.html) ® provides connected-system visibility and automated alerts that can help support teams identify potential issues sooner and troubleshoot with a clearer view of the system’s health.


But a signal is only useful when people know what to do with it. Engineers bring the expertise, communication, and accountability needed to understand the situation and help customers move forward. Our responsibility is to bring the reach and speed of technology together with the judgment and care of our people.


## **Where CX is going: From insight to action**


Technology and human expertise are part of CX today. The next step is to connect them with a stronger understanding of customer needs. A trusted, governed data foundation can bring customer feedback together with service and operational signals. AI can help surface patterns, risks, and opportunities; our people bring the judgment and customer relationships needed to decide what to do next.


Our opportunity is to move beyond measuring experience and responding after an issue appears. By bringing data, AI, and CX expertise together, we can anticipate customer needs, guide action, and support[data primacy](https://blog.everpuredata.com/perspectives/what-is-data-primacy/) and AI outcomes from early discovery through delivery. This is really about using our data and expertise to help customers make progress, while keeping people accountable for the relationship and the action.


## **Recognition—and the work ahead**


The Brandon Hall Group and SAMA awards recognize different programs. Together, they reflect capabilities that support a broader customer promise: helping people build confidence with our platform, providing knowledgeable support, and working in partnership around customers’ priorities.


We’re proud of this recognition and will continue listening to customers and partners, learning from their feedback, and improving how our teams, data, and technology work together. Thank you to our customers, partners, and employees whose trust and collaboration shape these programs. Your partnership helps us improve and keeps us focused on helping customers succeed.
